fields.title: record title
fields.published_at: when the Kingy record was published (UTC)
fields.launch_date: launch date stated in the record (YYYY-MM-DD)
fields.launch_type: Model Release / New Product / Major Update / Open-Source Release / Funding
fields.attributes: attributes such as Open Weight, API Available, Free Plan (multi)
fields.who_it_is_for: who the launch is for, as recorded
fields.pricing: pricing text as recorded (free text, may be stale)
fields.sources: source URLs listed on the record (multi)
fields.last_verified: date Kingy last verified the record
